headline: Python and PostgreSQL every day, from Django ORM models to query tuning.
pitch: I've written Python throughout my career: a stock-analysis tool for an Upwork client, a loan service's APIs and framework components at Equity, and AI agents at DGRS Labs. On PostgreSQL I optimized queries and caching to cut database reads by 40%, and I built frontends in TypeScript with Astro and Svelte before moving mainly to backend.

matches.evidence: Python across every role: Django REST Framework at Equity and for an Upwork client, reusable framework components at Equity, and AI agents at DGRS Labs. I also write Go and Rust.
Designed reusable USSD framework components that other engineers built on, and Loom's plugin architecture for connecting agents to external tools.

matches.requirement: Strong SQL, relational databases and DB design
matches.evidence: Optimized PostgreSQL queries and caching, cutting reads by 40% and API responses from 1.2s to 600ms. Worked with the Django ORM daily at Equity, where it stored and served the USSD menus.

matches.requirement: Autonomous, and eager to build real stuff
matches.evidence: Created Buckt and architected Loom at DGRS Labs, and run the company's entire infrastructure on my own.

matches.requirement: Fast JS framework, website builder and more
matches.evidence: Designed and built CoNexus's frontend in TypeScript with Astro and Svelte, and a TypeScript image-generation service.

resume.summary: Software engineer with 5+ years writing Python and PostgreSQL in production, in fintech and AI. Built a loan service's APIs with Django REST Framework and the Django ORM, optimized PostgreSQL queries and caching to cut database reads by 40%, and built frontends in TypeScript. Leads a team of three and runs the company's infrastructure. Previously led delivery of a USSD loan service on a financial platform serving 16 million customers.

note:
Odoo's backend is Python on PostgreSQL, which is what I've written most: Django REST Framework and the Django ORM at Equity, and PostgreSQL tuning at DGRS Labs. Open-source code with no client deadlines is an appealing way to do that work.

What I'd bring first is database sense: I've designed schemas, tuned slow queries and added caching where it paid off, and I'm comfortable on the frontend too.

What would be new: Odoo's own framework and its ORM, which I'd learn in onboarding. I'm in Lagos and would relocate to Belgium with your visa support.
